# Global Mechanisms to Improve Affordability of High-Priced Medicines: The Role of the WHO Model Lists of Essential Medicines

<!-- generated by scripts/generate_topic_pages.py -->

← Back to topic

**Authors:** Kristina Jenei  
**Year:** 2026  
**Journal:** Journal of Pharmaceutical Policy and Practice  
**DOI:** [10.1080/20523211.2025.2601935](https://doi.org/10.1080/20523211.2025.2601935)

**Keywords:** essential medicines, WHO, pharmaceutical pricing, affordability, health policy

## Abstract

Examines how WHO Essential Medicines List can improve affordability of high-priced medicines through voluntary licenses, pooled procurement, price transparency, and political advocacy mechanisms.
